I need to figure out which items open which doors. Let me try combining items to see if that helps. I'll start by combining shpers with kultmas to see what happens.

combine shper kultma

Interesting! Combining creates a vulkdub. Let me continue combining to create more vulkdubs, as this might be the key to opening doors.

combine shper kultma

I see - I can only hold one vulkdub at a time. Let me try using this vulkdub on a door to see if it works.

use vulkdub stisk_1

The vulkdub didn't open the door, but it yielded vralk_1. Let me try using it on a different door.
